Name: (CP) BB's New Livestock - Platypus
Author: Bibliobeast
Description:
[size=4][b]Increase your animal diversity by adding platypuses to your farm!

[/b][/size][size=3]A bit of a smaller mod this time around as a fun little addition~ 

[/size][size=4]Features[/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]Adds platypuses to your farm as a barn animal[/size]
[*][size=3]Has custom swim animation frames (warning, I suspect there is a conflict with Better Water or water-editing tile sheets. Platypuses will still swim but won't be offset)[/size]
[*][size=3]Produces eggs and high friendship unlocks the chance to drop platypus milk[/size]
[*][size=3]Platypus eggs -> Mayonnaise ; Platypus Milk -> Cheese -> Aged Cheese [/size]
[*][size=3]No unlocking required, added to Marnie's shop immediately[/size]
[/list]
[size=4]Installation Notes[/size]
[size=3]This mod requires both SMAPI and Content Patcher to function. I also recommend Livestock Bazaar to find this animal in Marnie's shop smoothly. [/size]

[list=1]
[*][size=3]Download and install the latest SMAPI and Content Patcher mod updates.[/size]
[*][size=3]Download and unzip [CP] BBs Platypuses, then move it to your Mods folder. [/size]
[/list]
[size=3]Patch Notes[/size]
[size=2]V 1.1 - Fixed bug where your name for certain NPCs was "Platypus_egg" when giving a gift

[/size][size=3][u]Future Updates[/u]
[list]
[*][size=3]Investigate a work around for the custom swimming frames[/size]
[*][size=3]Add blonde, piebald, 'undercover' and void skins[/size]
[/list][/size]
